name: MPD-75
summary: MPD-75, also known as 1-methyl-N-pyrrolidyllysergamide or as 1-methyllysergic acid pyrrolidide, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the 1-methyl derivative of lysergic acid pyrrolidide (LA-Pyr; LPD-824) and the N-pyrrolidide analogue of 1-methyl-LSD (MLD-41).

pharmacology.text: In animal studies, MPD-75 had 4% of the toxicity of LSD in rabbits (presumably in terms of LD50), 0% of its pyretogenic activity in rabbits, and 130% of its antiserotonergic activity in the isolated rat uterus.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: MPD-75 was evaluated in humans and was found to produce partial LSD-like effects. It was reported to have had a faster onset and shorter duration compared to LSD.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of this kind can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, raised heart rate and blood pressure, and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類迷幻藥可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳和血壓上升以及驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类迷幻药可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳和血压上升以及惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: MPD-75 combines two changes to LSD: a methyl group on the indole nitrogen, as in the migraine drug methysergide, and a pyrrolidine ring in place of LSD's diethylamide.
fact.zh: MPD-75 結合了對 LSD 的兩項改變：在吲哚氮原子上加甲基（和偏頭痛藥美西麥角相同），以及用吡咯啶環取代 LSD 的二乙胺基。
fact.zhHans: MPD-75 结合了对 LSD 的两项改变：在吲哚氮原子上加甲基（和偏头痛药美西麦角相同），以及用吡咯啶环取代 LSD 的二乙胺基。
